bug_fixed.name: _clean_user_project_runtime_snapshot
bug_fixed.summary: The /save-run user_created branch referenced a module-level function that was never defined anywhere in the codebase. This caused a NameError on every save for a user_created project, which the broad except Exception caught and surfaced as 200 + save_result-err with message 'Model error: name _clean_user_project_runtime_snapshot is not defined'.
bug_fixed.preserved_in: Phase 51G-2 (extraction preserved the bug as documented/pinned behavior)

behavior_before.http_response: 200 + partials/save_result.html with success=False and error='Model error: name _clean_user_project_runtime_snapshot is not defined'
behavior_before.persistence_side_effects: NONE — neither save_run nor save_project was called
behavior_before.return_path: Returned SaveRunRouteOutcome(context={'success': False, 'error': 'Model error: name _clean_user_project_runtime_snapshot is not defined'})

behavior_after.summary: User-created project save reaches run_project + save_run + save_project on the success path; on a malformed baseline_snapshot, surfaces a clean SnapshotInputError message (not a NameError)
behavior_after.http_response_on_valid_input: 200 + partials/save_result.html with success=True and {run_id, project_type, scenario, created_at}
behavior_after.http_response_on_malformed_input: 200 + partials/save_result.html with success=False and error=<SnapshotInputError message from build_projectinputs_from_snapshot>
behavior_after.persistence_side_effects: 1 save_run call (RunRecord row) + 1 save_project call (ProjectRecord.last_run_summary update); ordering preserved; save_project.runtime_timestamp = run_record.created_at.isoformat(); save_project.replay_metadata.project_id = None
behavior_after.return_path: SaveRunRouteOutcome(context={'success': True, 'run_id': ..., 'project_type': ..., 'scenario': ..., 'created_at': ...}) on success; SaveRunRouteOutcome(context={'success': False, 'error': ...}) on SnapshotInputError

remaining_risks: If a user_created project has a malformed baseline_snapshot (e.g. missing one of the 17 required fields), build_projectinputs_from_snapshot raises SnapshotInputError. The broad except Exception (Behavior 12) catches it and returns 200 + save_result-err with the validation message. This is a clean error path, not a crash, and is a user-actionable error (the user should re-check the project's baseline data).

The new dep clean_user_project_runtime_snapshot delegates to _resolve_runtime_snapshot_source which is the Phase 50C-2 canonical implementation. This is a thin adapter — any future change to the runtime snapshot resolution policy would automatically flow through to /save-run's user_created branch. This is desirable (single source of truth) but means /save-run's user_created branch depends on scenario_state_service.
All 14 other characterized quirks (or 6 after quirk 1 is resolved) remain preserved. Future refactors must keep them as a unit.

The 51G-1 latent-bug test name is preserved (test_user_created_branch_has_latent_name_error) even though the bug is now fixed. This is intentional: the name documents the bug history. The test body has been updated to assert the FIXED state. A separate test in 51G-3 explicitly documents the bug history.
